newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mandela to make four-stop Asian tour.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mandela to make four-stop Asian tour.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela will start a 10-day, four-country tour of Asia on February 28, Deputy Foreign Minister Aziz Pahad said on Tuesday.

He told reporters Mandela would visit Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines and Brunei as part of a plan by South Africa to organise official trips to strategic partners in Asia, the Middle East and Latin America.
Deputy President Thabo Mbeki would visit Germany from June 4 to establish a bi-national commission and attend an investment seminar in Bonn.
"In March, the minister of trade and industry (Alec Erwin) will be leading a delegation to France for the first Franco- South African bi-national economic commission," Pahad said.
